celestial-dome-observatory.challenge: Aligning 16 high-resolution projectors across hemispherical acoustics without optical overlap artifacts.
celestial-dome-observatory.approach: We deployed automated camera-based geometric warp algorithms.

chrono-echoes-artifact-wall.title: Chrono Echoes Artifact Wall

chrono-echoes-artifact-wall.challenge: Protecting rare physical artifacts while illuminating fine visual details.
chrono-echoes-artifact-wall.approach: We used low-UV directional micro-projection with proximity sensors.

interactive-museum-exhibit.title: Interactive Museum Exhibit
interactive-museum-exhibit.overview: A sprawling interactive museum exhibit combining architectural projection mapping with motion-responsive floors to teach physics, astronomy, and world history through tactile exploration.
interactive-museum-exhibit.challenge: Designing a high-throughput, wear-free installation that handles thousands of daily student groups without mechanical wear or hygiene concerns.
interactive-museum-exhibit.approach: We engineered an overhead laser tracking matrix and optical floor projection system that responds to hundreds of children concurrently without requiring tags or touchscreens.

corporate-lobby-installation.title: Corporate Lobby Installation
corporate-lobby-installation.experienceType: Generative AI Motion Wall & Real-Time Data Canvas
corporate-lobby-installation.overview: A landmark 24-meter interactive architectural media wall in an enterprise headquarters, visualizing live global environmental data and responding dynamically to executive foot traffic.
corporate-lobby-installation.challenge: Achieving seamless multi-projector laser blending and LiDAR footstep tracking across a curved polished concrete atrium flooded with natural daylight through 30-foot glass curtain walls.
corporate-lobby-installation.approach: We deployed 30,000-lumen high-contrast laser projection engines with motorized optical geometry correction, paired with overhead 3D LiDAR sensors and real-time Unreal Engine 5 simulation servers.

pediatric-hospital-floor.title: Pediatric Hospital Floor
pediatric-hospital-floor.overview: Calming interactive aquatic environments projected onto pediatric hospital corridors, reducing stress and encouraging gentle physical rehabilitation for young patients.
pediatric-hospital-floor.challenge: Strict hospital sanitation rules banning physical equipment or cables on clinical floors, alongside sensitive patient emotional states.
pediatric-hospital-floor.approach: We mounted all optical projection and motion tracking hardware safely above ceiling tiles, projecting soft water ripples and swimming fish onto the existing hospital floor.

flagship-store-activation.title: Flagship Store Activation
flagship-store-activation.overview: An experiential retail flagship installation on a luxury shopping boulevard where footsteps trigger blooming floral patterns and dynamic product highlights on luxury displays.
flagship-store-activation.challenge: Attracting foot traffic from busy street sidewalks and converting casual window shoppers into engaged in-store visitors.
flagship-store-activation.approach: We installed high-brightness rear-projection window glass combined with interior interactive motion floor tiles that react in real-time as shoppers browse.

neo-tokyo-retail-popup.title: Neo-Tokyo Retail Pop-Up
neo-tokyo-retail-popup.overview: A futuristic retail pop-up in Tokyo's Shinjuku district featuring interactive sneaker projection mapping tables and responsive graffiti walls.
neo-tokyo-retail-popup.challenge: Fitting ultra-high-density interactive technology into a compact footprint with rapid 48-hour pop-up assembly and teardown.
neo-tokyo-retail-popup.approach: We developed modular self-calibrating projection pedestals with embedded computer vision tracking that calibrate automatically upon power-up.

ai-receptionist-avatar.title: AI Receptionist Avatar
ai-receptionist-avatar.experienceType: Conversational AI Avatar Embedded in Architectural Mirrors
ai-receptionist-avatar.overview: A real-time conversational AI avatar host integrated into smart two-way architectural mirrors, welcoming executive visitors and handling guest passes autonomously.
ai-receptionist-avatar.challenge: Eliminating uncanny-valley delays while delivering natural voice interaction in noisy corporate reception atriums.
ai-receptionist-avatar.approach: We engineered ultra-low-latency voice synthesis with directional beamforming microphone arrays and high-definition micro-LED projection behind dielectric glass.

sensory-interactive-therapy-room.title: Sensory Interactive Therapy Room
sensory-interactive-therapy-room.experienceType: Calming Motion Floor & Pediatric Rehabilitation System
sensory-interactive-therapy-room.overview: A therapeutic motion projection room engineered for pediatric rehabilitation, motor skill improvement, and sensory decompression in medical centers.
sensory-interactive-therapy-room.challenge: Creating a fully hygienic, easy to sanitize, and soothing environment for children.
sensory-interactive-therapy-room.approach: We utilized contactless floor motion projection with gentle ambient soundscapes.

generative-ai-mirror-room.title: Generative AI Mirror Room
generative-ai-mirror-room.overview: A real-time generative AI mirror chamber reacting to visitor movement, voice, and facial gestures with dynamic digital avatars.
generative-ai-mirror-room.challenge: Synthesizing 60fps real-time neural renders without latency while tracking multiple audience posture cues simultaneously.
generative-ai-mirror-room.approach: We deployed edge neural processors paired with optical camera depth matrices.

quantum-prism-passage.title: Quantum Prism Passage
quantum-prism-passage.overview: A walk-through sensory tunnel using synchronized projection and optical mirror reflection geometry.
quantum-prism-passage.challenge: Creating seamless mirror infinity reflections in high-traffic public concourses.
quantum-prism-passage.approach: We combined optical projection mapping with infinite glass reflection physics.
